create_AXK1ForCausalLM: create an inference-only A.X K1 causal language model with vLLM config and quantization support
build_AXK1MoE: build a mixture-of-experts MLP layer with routed and shared experts using tensor and expert parallelism
build_AXK1Attention: build an AXK1 attention module with MLA or MHA support, rotary embeddings, and llama-4 scaling
build_AXK1DecoderLayer: build a decoder layer with self-attention and sparse or dense MLP using residual connections and RMSNorm
load_AXK1_weights: load model weights from checkpoint with support for stacked param fusion, expert sharding, and FP8 scales
